g.text: SYS01 - Successful deployment with isolated PostgreSQL validation
Resolve and validate candidate commit SHA
Apply migrations and execute PostgreSQL suites
Run lint, Jest, health integration, build and bundle scan
Candidate tests use only the ephemeral runner database.
The shared DEI PostgreSQL service is not contacted by CI tests.
Verify SSH host key; stage candidate images and manifest
Preserve current release and schema version
[Stop deploy before shared migration or candidate activation]
Archive sanitized gate failure and test results
Create separate scratch DB at current schema version
Apply candidate migration to scratch DB
Transfer retained image over verified SSH; verify image ID
Run backward-compatibility suite against scratch DB
Reads and writes pass on migrated schema
Apply versioned migration to shared DEI database
Select installed configuration revision for candidate
docker compose up -d; replace web/API containers
Single-host replacement may briefly interrupt requests.
GET /api/v1/health and routed API smoke checks
HTTPS prerequisite, SPA fallback and proxy checks pass
Record candidate SHA, image IDs, config and schema version
Archive sanitized logs, tests and release manifest
Deployment successful; release queue slot released
`deploy.yml` repeats validation steps and requires RUN_DATABASE_TESTS=1.
Runner PostgreSQL is isolated; only deployment migration/runtime traffic
